status: candidate; built from source, not run on GPUs. Nothing here has been built yet.

nccl_and_toolchain.role: Builds NCCL v2.30.7-1 for sm_121 (nvcc 13.0.x). Not in the final image.

runtime.dockerfile_stage: runtime-base (also the parent of the tools, recipe, engine, ropetools and final stages)
runtime.role: Final image base, and the base of the CPU-only build stages so they share its layers

contents_from_image_config.NV_LIBCUBLAS_PACKAGE: libcublas-13-0=13.1.1.3-1 (libcublas.so.13 and libcublasLt.so.13; the engine dlopens both)
contents_from_image_config.libnccl2: 2.28.3-1+cuda13.0 (apt-held; the final stage removes it so only NCCL 2.30.7 remains)

base_images.digest_note: Both digests are the linux/arm64 manifests inside the multi-arch indexes of nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-{devel,runtime}-ubuntu24.04, resolved on 2026-10-24 over the registry HTTP API with an anonymous token (GET https://nvcr.io/proxy_auth?scope=repository:nvidia/cuda:pull, then GET /v2/nvidia/cuda/manifests/<tag> with Accept for the OCI index or Docker manifest list; pick platform linux/arm64). The image configs were read from the manifests' config blobs. Docker could not be run locally, so nothing was built or run.

ubuntu_apt_snapshot.note: apt-snapshot-install.sh replaces every apt source in a stage with this dated snapshot, so the unpinned dependencies of the packages below resolve identically on every build. The snapshot serves the arm64 indexes and pool; one arm64 .deb (libibverbs1) was downloaded from it and matched the recorded sha256.

packages.name: curl
packages.note: NVIDIA CUDA images purge curl after setup; needed for the NCCL and Zig downloads. sha256 from the snapshot noble-updates arm64 index.

packages.name: ibverbs-providers
packages.note: Includes the libmlx5 provider for ConnectX-7. Must match the host's mlx5 kernel ABI.

ubuntu_apt_snapshot.conditional: The nccl stage installs gcc, g++ and make from the snapshot, unpinned, only if the CUDA devel image does not already carry them (not verified; no container run was possible).

upstream_recipe.license: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 LakyFx); does not relicense third-party code or the model
upstream_recipe.fetch: git init, git fetch --depth 1 --filter=blob:none <commit>, git sparse-checkout set --cone tensorfold, checkout; git rev-parse HEAD is asserted equal to the commit and git status must be clean (core.autocrlf=false; upstream binds exact bytes with tensorfold/** -text)

recipe_file.note: This is the launcher's recipe identity (BUILD.json recipe_manifest_sha256). The value ed9c269ab2e5774cdb1869d63471feed84b4a5955b05dbbc9e150d53c970f1c6 quoted in the upstream QUALIFICATION.json (native_manifest_sha256) belongs to the recipe file measured earlier under the alias 1.2.4k2a; the blob at v1.2.5 hashes to the value above (checked from git cat-file, and the GitHub contents API reports the same blob id).

shipped_inputs.note: tensorfold/extract.py verifies these against tensorfold/inputs.json before extracting.

engine.name: TensorFold (Zig engine); frozen fork of ashhart/TensorFold with the dsv41 family, RDMA ring and tf-dsv41-lanes (BertholomusAI), carried in the recipe as tensorfold-source.tar.gz
engine.k2a_overlay: 27 files overlaid by tensorfold/variants/recipes/k2a.json; final source tree 1,137 files, verified by sha256 before and after the build

recorded_upstream_binaries_for_reference.note: Upstream records that a rebuild can differ and that launch compares only with the local BUILD.json. These are not asserted.

zig.note: Build stage only; not in the final image. Same tarball and hash as the Qwen3.8-Flash TensorFold image.

nccl.sha256_note: Computed on 2026-10-24 by downloading the tarball twice (identical both times). codeload tarballs are generated by GitHub; if GitHub changes its archive encoding the build fails at sha256sum -c and this value must be recomputed from the tag.
nccl.build: make -C /opt/nccl-src -j2 src.build CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda NVCC_GENCODE="-gencode=arch=compute_121,code=sm_121" (upstream build/Dockerfile L18-L19); the build asserts NCCL_VERSION_CODE 23007 in nccl.h
nccl.installed_as: /usr/local/lib/libnccl.so.2.30.7 (+ libnccl.so.2 via ldconfig); libnccl2 2.28.3 from the base image is purged
nccl.license: Apache-2.0 for most of the project, BSD-3-Clause for parts that keep their original license (LICENSE.txt and ThirdPartyNotices.txt are shipped in /usr/share/doc/nccl)
nccl.provenance_note: Upstream documents only this source build (vLLM-path Dockerfile) and the requirement 'NCCL 2.30.7'; that K2a production used the same build is inferred.

rope.hash_source: tensorfold/rope-hashes.json['10000000'] at the pinned commit; also embedded in selfcheck.py
rope.python: CPython 3.12 (Ubuntu 24.04), venv /opt/rope-venv in the ropetools stage, never copied into the image

pip.note: Upstream qualified torch 2.13.0+cpu and names numpy without a version, so numpy 2.5.4 is Petabridge's choice. The generated tables are asserted byte-identical to the qualified hashes, which is the actual criterion.

runtime_models.note: Weights are NOT in the image. They are bind-mounted at /srv/ds41f-tensorfold/weights.

pillow.purpose: The engine's image decoder child (zig/src/families/dsv41/pil.zig runs python3 with `from PIL import Image`). Without it, non-PNG images are refused.
pillow.why_this_version: pil.zig: decoded pixels match the qualified serving image's Pillow 12.3.0
pillow.install: pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all: --target /opt/pillow in the pillow stage, copied to /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages
pillow.license: MIT-CMU (Pillow); the wheel's bundled codecs (libjpeg-turbo, libwebp, zlib, ...) under their own licenses
